31: The true story of technical troubles that scuttle the Apollo 13 lunar mission in 1970, risking the lives of astronaut Jim Lovell and his crew, with the failed journey turning into a thrilling saga of heroism. Drifting more than 200,000 miles from Earth, the astronauts work furiously with the ground crew to avert tragedy.
287: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.
You don't know what you've got 'til it's...

Just when his world is back to normal... he's in for the surprise of his life!
799: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.
Be careful what you wish for.
Mr. Sergei Alexander Bobinsky / Other Bobinsky (voice)
1055: Famed monster slayer Gabriel Van Helsing is dispatched to Transylvania to assist the last of the Valerious bloodline in defeating Count Dracula. The one name they all fear.
1311: Australian outback expert protects his New York love from gangsters who've followed her down under.
The world's favorite adventurer is back for more. Much more!
1567: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.
1823: A master thief coincidentally is robbing a house where a murder—in which the President of the United States is involved—occurs in front of his eyes. He is forced to run, while holding evidence that could convict the President.

Anarene, Texas, 1951. Nothing much has changed…

Give a father no options and you leave him no choice.

What do you do when justice fails?

Moscow's toughest detective. Chicago's craziest cop. There's only one thing worse than making them mad. Making them partners.
4127: A career officer and his wife work with a police detective to uncover the truth behind their son's disappearance following his return from a tour of duty in Iraq.
Sometimes finding the truth is easier than facing it.

4639: A young lunatic director and his devoted cult of cinema terrorists kidnap a Hollywood movie goddess and force her to star in their radical underground movie.
4895: A heartfelt documentary focusing on the day-to-day lives of professional wrestlers, some on the rise, some on the wane, and others fighting for their lives.
The Movie Vince McMahon Doesn't Want You to See.
5151: A man becomes increasingly jealous of his friend's newfound success.
Success didn’t go to his head, it went to his neighbor.
5407: When an uptight young man and his fiancée move into his libertine mother's house, the resulting clash of life attitudes shakes everyone up.
Somewhere between Hollywood and the rest of the world.
5663: This war drama depicts the U.S. and Japanese forces in the naval Battle of Midway, which became a turning point for Americans during World War II.
The glory, the suspense, the spectacular drama of the men who won the most decisive naval battle in our history!
Vice Adm. William F. 'Bull' Halsey Jr.
5919: A mistaken delivery in Mumbai's famously efficient lunchbox delivery system (Mumbai's Dabbawallahs) connects a young housewife to a stranger in the dusk of his life. Can you fall in love with someone you have never met?

All Hannah wanted was a roommate... instead she got a best friend.
6431: After an abandoned boat sails into New York harbor with a zombie aboard, a reporter teams up with the daughter of the boat's missing captain to investigate the island where he was last seen conducting research—the site of an alleged zombie outbreak.
We are going to eat you!

It was supposed to be a routine prisoner transfer. But this was no ordinary prisoner.

7711: An opportunistic singer woos a wealthy widow to boost his career.
8223: Two untalented singers are mistaken for a pair of major league safe crackers in Providence, Rhode Island. Romantic interest is added by the daughter of the underworld leader who won't date the men she knows are gangsters.
Welcome to the world of disorganised crime.
8479: In Depression-era Winnipeg, a legless beer baroness hosts a contest for the saddest music in the world, offering a grand prize of $25,000.
"If you're sad, and like beer, I'm your lady."

Go back before the beginning, to the place where evil was born.

10015: Police investigate when a man having an affair with his brother's wife disappears suddenly.
No one's ever been so good at being so bad.
10271: A quiet, epileptic taxidermist plans the perfect crime. All he needs is the right opportunity. An accident, perhaps…

One U.S. astronaut pitted against all the odds beyond this earth!

The way back begins with a single chord.

The scientist Rumata tries to save the local intellectuals from their punishment and cannot avoid taking a position.

The murder trial that shook the world!

Contracted to kill. Fighting to survive.

Of course, unfaithful employees and/or rivals conspire to bring about Ace's fall.

It's not a lie if you believe it.

13599: A wooden puppet embarks on a thrilling adventure to become a real boy.

14367: Tom and Jerry are two hit men, they work by day at a third-rate second-hand car dealership. Tom is a veteran and Jerry is a novice in their business, and their attitude toward their profession differs a lot. It shows when Tom is required to kill his old friend Karl.

A Brand New Seven -- Doing Their Number! They put their lives on the line and let it ride!
15391: A doctor in early 19th-century Germany becomes infatuated with the sister of a man he unintentionally killed and bargains with the Devil incarnate to conjure their union in exchange for his soul.

The new adventures of the "Cheaper By the Dozen" family!

Where sin abounds... grace abounds more

Fighting crime the only way he knows how. Badly.

100,000 gallons of water. 50 meters wide. NO. WAY. OUT.

20767: In 1969, a young Beijing student, Chen Zhen, is sent to live among the nomadic herdsmen of Inner Mongolia. 21023: The closing of a local restaurant concerns a number of employees who've dedicated their lives to the eatery
You can't wash out all the color and keep the flavor.
21279: A career assassin becomes haunted by one of her victims following a near fatal injury to her brain. Becoming a rogue assassin settling the score with her former mob employers, chaos and power struggles ensue.

Meet the Mastermind Who Pulls the Strings in the Underworld...and all his mobs and dolls...filling the London fog with laughter and lunacy!!!

She built one life on love, the other on deceit

22303: A young heiress finds evidence suggesting that at night she acts under the influence of a family curse and has begun committing ghastly murders in a nearby park.
A woman whose hatred knew no bounds!
22559: A self-help guru's televised teachings inspire a down-and-out businessman to pursue his dream of making a movie.
22815: Hoping to find answers to her estranged father's mysterious illness, a young woman visits his old villa and uncovers a horrifying truth from the past.
23071: Harsha, a multi-millionaire guy who has everything but there is something else he's looking for and in the process he adopts a complete village trying to bring change in the people.

Imagine waking up and everyday is Christmas day.

As they make their way through the lethal no-man's land, they must confront not only the enemy, but also their own fears and inner demons. Fueled by the Wehrmacht's methamphetamine, their mission increasingly becomes a journey into the heart of darkness.
24607: Yudhra, who is struggling with anger issues, is assigned an undercover mission to bring down a powerful drug syndicate headed by Firoz and his son Shafiq. Yudhra accepts the responsibility as he wants to exact revenge against Firoz for his parents's death.

Some memories not only haunt us... They find us.
25119: Set in the backdrop of a film set, in the 1950’s in post colonial Madras, the film is centred around the professional rivalry between a film-maker trying to make his seminal film and the top reigning actor who the director once introduced. The rivalry spirals around the leading actress, a debutante and as the relationship between the three.
25375: The film is about Little Vuk, the son of the legendary fox who proves its excellent mind and courage.
25631: Breaking conventional barriers, a poor, disabled orphan befriends the son of a wealthy businessman. However, their friendship is put to the test after both friends fall in love with the same woman.
Special Appearance in "Dekha Hai Pehli Baar" Song
25887: Kevin Mitnick is quite possibly the best hacker in the world. Hunting for more and more information, seeking more and more cyber-trophies every day, he constantly looks for bigger challenges. When he breaks into the computer of a security expert and an ex-hacker, he finds one - and much more than that...
The world has a right to know.

When the two sons of a local landlord have a property dispute and decide to hire Aromal and Aringodar to duel it out, Chanthu has to decide where his loyalty lies - with the family of the uncle who brought him up or with Aringodar who provided him with sanctuary.
26399: After retirement, a Shakespearean theater actor, divides his property amongst his two children. However, their ungratefulness leaves him and his wife homeless during their old age.
26655: A happy-go-lucky Mumbai suburban housewife Sulochana, fondly known as Sulu, lands the role of a night RJ, resulting in drastic changes to her routine life.
26911: During the Hyderabad Liberation Movement of 1948, there will be atrocities, like the episode of Gundrampally, Parkala, Bhairanpally villages.
27167: During the 13th century, a small village fights for freedom in the frontier landscape of the Carpathian Mountains against Mongolian invaders.
27423: The comical story of Şaban, who came to Istanbul to earn his dowry and, by chance, became a famous folk singer known as Şaban Ballıses.

Canada, enforcing discriminatory immigration laws, denied entry to most passengers who were of Indian descent. After two months of legal battles and protests, the ship was forced to return to India. 27935: Four brothers try to find the mystery behind the murder of woman who raised them.
28191: When a romance between a widow and a notorious libertine takes an unexpected turn, Mademoiselle de Joncquières becomes instrumental to one lover’s plans for revenge.

And when Vishnu professes to remember nothing of what he had done, the father takes him to a psychiatrist.
28959: A black-market cabbie drives criminals at breakneck speeds until she is left in charge of a fugitive's son.
29471: Rakesh, a happy-go-lucky young mechanic, must take on the ruthless land grabber Rankireddy to save his beloved ancestral car garage, uncovering unexpected truths.
29727: An aspiring filmmaker goes to shocking extremes to convince Hollywood actress Anne Hathaway to star in his film. First entry in Adrian Țofei's spiritual trilogy which includes We Put the World to Sleep and Pure.
"I will change the world with you, Anne!"
29983: Ekrem is an ice cream seller who goes through a number of funny adventures as he tries to win the heart of Nese, the woman he loves.
30239: This historical drama is an account of the early life of British politician Winston Churchill, including his childhood years, his time as a war correspondent in Africa, and culminating with his first election to Parliament.
Rebel Soldier Hustler Prisoner Fugitive Firebrand

With no rescue in sight, Reagan must use every ounce of strength he has left to break free and get his revenge.
The kidnapping was just the beginning.

As the building is to be renovated, Mithat develops a friendship with concierge Ali, another loner, who helps him save his collection. They involuntarily change each other’s fate.
31007: A feature length, theatrical documentary on the life of Paul Gascoigne, one of the greatest footballers that ever lived: delving deep into his psyche, vulnerabilities, fears and triumphs.
The man. The legend. His story. His words.

32031: An innocent trucker takes it on the lam when he's accused of robbery.
MURDER at any moment! SUSPENSE... in every step!!!

32543: When a former BlackRose cartel assassin deliberately betrays them by refusing to complete her mission, the cartel orders her execution. When the cartel discovers she is alive, the hunter becomes the hunted as she fights to get revenge on those who took her new life away from her.

After a series of failed tries, Deok-hye makes her final attempt to return home with help of her childhood sweetheart, Jang-han.
Based on the true story of the last princess of the last empire.

You can have rhythm without music but you can't have music without rhythm.

37407: Physically separated from her father and at odds with her distraught mother, a girl must negotiate her own passage to maturity.

Harriet Anderson / Mandy Anderson (as Ann Jeider)

Pray for the Devil Within Her...before it preys on you!

They won because they couldn't lose

They give new meaning to the term "full-service station"!

"Honeymoon's over... it's time to get married."

A very special kind of stupid
Big Fat Party Guy / XXXL / Before / Michael Moore / Ogre / Preston Lacy Doll / Mrs. Smith
My Little Buddy / Wee-Man Doll / Cricket / Mobutu
Gregg / Luigi / Cathy Ace / Joshua Benson / Other Fly / Stranger
Dr. Lakin / Announcer / Lieutenant / Six Million Year Old Man / Cowboy

Silence Is The Most Powerful Scream

Just because you can't see them, doesn't mean they can't see you.

This year, it's not the turkey being carved for Thanksgiving
